envelope.description: Identity and draft-issue loaders: await and denial rethrow

body.title: Identity and draft-issue loaders: await and denial rethrow
body.summary: Make the LoadTracker forms in draft-issues.ts and identity-service.ts asynchronous with their callers, and add the ToolDenied rethrow in idOf (both catches), resolveLearner and ensureDraftIssues.
acceptanceChecks: a denial inside idOf, resolveLearner or ensureDraftIssues stops the stage with no fallback identity, no unavailable status and no not-ready result
a non-denial failure keeps the old fallback

tests.name: identity-draft-denial.test.ts: a denial inside idOf, resolveLearner and ensureDraftIssues stops the stage; a non-denial failure keeps the old fallback
